labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for new behaviour: unit styling in ReprHighlighter is a feature request

body:
This is a feature request. Per the feature template, new features need to be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there.

Rich does not style units today. Until a feature is approved, you can already do this with a custom highlighter that extends `RegexHighlighter`, as shown in [the highlighting docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst). A related open report about the number regex is #3318.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
